positioning: Freelance web developer based in Himachal Pradesh, working remotely with small businesses across all of India (hotels, cafes, gyms, clinics, coaching centres, salons, shops, D2C brands) to help them grow online.
audience: Small and medium business owners anywhere in India, plus freelancers and agencies for the lead-gen service. Work is done fully online, in English and Hindi/Hinglish.

services.name: Website development
services.pitch: Fast, mobile-first websites for small businesses anywhere in India (hotels, cafes, gyms, clinics, coaching centres, salons, shops).
services.price_note: Packages from INR 1,499 (Basic) up to INR 3,599 (Bundle 2); domain setup INR 800.

services.name: AI chatbot development
services.pitch: AI chatbot that answers customer questions and takes enquiries automatically, so no lead goes unanswered.
services.price_note: INR 2,999 or INR 4,999, plus INR 299/month maintenance.

services.name: AI animated ads
services.pitch: Short animated ads for small businesses anywhere in India to use on Instagram and Facebook.

services.name: Lead generation (LocalSignal)
services.pitch: Daily Excel sheet of pre-qualified businesses (found via Google Places plus website analysis) for freelancers and agencies, so they can pitch without cold-searching for hours.
services.price_note: Do not state a price; tell people to DM.

services.name: Reel script writing
services.pitch: Hinglish/English reel scripts for small businesses across India.

services.name: SEO blog writing
services.pitch: Monthly SEO blog writing for small businesses across India.

facts_rules: No testimonials, client names, results, or statistics exist yet. Never invent any.
Only quote prices that appear in price_note. Never promise rankings, revenue or guaranteed results.
Primary goal of every post: earn DMs/messages.
Audience is all of India: do not assume one city or state; use examples from varied industries and cities, and national (not city-specific) hashtags.
Any project shown is a sample, demo or concept project unless stated otherwise by the owner; never describe it as client work.
Posts must read as a developer showing real work, not as an advertisement.
Do not state counts or timeframes about the owner's work (projects built, days taken, clients) unless given here.

Offers allowed in posts: a quick look at someone's site/page with 3 things to fix (free), a sample page (free), and 'pay after approval' on every service (the client pays only after approving the work). Do not invent any other free offers, discounts, guarantees, refunds or payment terms.

languages.instagram: Hindi written in Hinglish (Roman script), everyday spoken Hindi with English tech words

offers.pay_after_approval: Applies to every service: the client pays only after approving the work.

schedule.note: Websites are saturated in India: 1 post per week only. Core = priority 1 (chatbots, AI ads, lead gen), rotating by least recently used. Weekdays: Monday=0. One reel a day on Instagram, posted manually.
